notes.content: [p]Hello, players! I'm Qiuhe, the developer of "Ocean Current Punk". It's been a while since we last met. Today, we are going to release the 1.8 version update. [/p][p]Last month, we restarted the update plan and launched the "Adventure" DLC. We are truly grateful for the experience and support from our friends. The upcoming updates will also include updates for the Adventure DLC. Please stay tuned. [/p][p]In August, I redid several "neglected" characters. I hope you'll like them. At the same time, I have been continuously optimizing based on player feedback. Currently, the overall gameplay experience has been greatly improved. I'm looking forward to your experience. notes.title: We're Back! Indie Release · Ongoing Update(Support the Adventure DLC, nya—thank)
notes.content: [p]Dear players, it's been a long time since we last met. I'm Quge. You may have noticed that the game has suddenly started to update again recently. Yes, I'm back. [/p][p][b]In the first half of the year, due to the reasons of the publisher (running away), the game was unable to participate in the activities and enjoy discounts. Therefore, I temporarily decided to suspend the game's updates.[/b] [/p][p]After a period of negotiation, fortunately, I eventually revoked the game's access rights and they completely withdrew from the game's operation. From now on, it will be managed solely by me. [/p][p]This has given me great confidence and room for growth. Thank you to all the players for your continuous support and attention. Let's witness the development of this game together in the future! [/p][p][i]Perhaps you have noticed: The game store page now features a new DLC (Dungeon Crawl Classics) and OST (Original Soundtrack).[/i] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41857044/5d400020fc319bd975fe1b1837ee2d1f229f3c8a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I'm very sorry. I have directly separated out some of the original adventure gameplay content and made it into a DLC. Due to the rising cost of living, my wallet is not able to cover the expenses. Therefore, I have to find ways to earn additional income to ensure the continuation of development. This is why I started the development of a new small game in the first half of the year. I will do my best to pursue my dream because I love indie games and I also hope to share them with more people. [/p][p]During this period of silence, a lot has happened. My mindset has also undergone a significant transformation. I have many thoughts that I want to share with you all, but at this moment, I don't know what to say. So, let's just go back to the game update. Let's see what changes the game has made! notes.title: Multi-layer structure; The Space Factory; Prisoner chaplain
notes.content:
[h2] Preface [/h2]

Hello everyone, I am seeking cooperation, after unremitting efforts, we finally ushered in the first important update in 2025, after more than two months of development, the game added a lot of new features let's take a look. The first is the long-awaited "hull multi-layer structure" and space gameplay, where we have added a lot of resources and building blueprints, and now our base can launch satellites! At the same time, we worked on the humanities, giving the crew more identity tags, they will perform more interesting random actions in different states, and we also fixed a few bugs and details optimization.

Unconsciously, Ocean Current has been on the market for two years, during which I have maintained steady updates, and players have continued to give me encouragement and feedback, I really appreciate it. In the next 2025, I hope we can improve this game even better, and we will add more island terrain, biomes, faction communication, quality of life, and architectural blueprints.

(Secretly tell you a little secret: I am also making a new game of meat pigeon dungeon, if you are interested in this kind of gameplay of the game please do not forget to pay attention to my home page oh, here I guarantee that the development of the new game will not suspend the update progress of the ocean current, please rest assured and supervision, thank you ~)

[h2] Hull multi-layer structure [/h2]

[list]
[*] Added 5 layers of hull structure, players can build pillars to expand the hull space
[*] Added stone column: 25 force, 10 decoration (stone brick material)
[*] New steel column: 250 force, -10 decoration (steel, ship components)
[*] Gameplay rules: (upper level open need to verify the force of the lower level)
[*] 1~2: Small force requirements recommend the use of stone columns
[*] 3~5: The force requirements are large recommended steel columns
[/list]

[h2] Perfect space [/h2]

[b] New resources [/b]

[list]
[*] Atomic ore: extremely dense, hardest material (lacquer black)
[*] Superconducting ore: Helping higher space technology
[*] Aerogel: Thermal insulation, viscosity
[*] Bioooze: Key materials for life sciences
[*] Fire Gel (100) : The resource with the highest fuel value (electric furnace: fire stone + aerogel)
[/list]

[b] Space Factory (New Technology node) [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41857044/1fd97a664f45a8aee21b9925c580bc3eb931dabf.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Atomic Shield: Buffer the ship deck from any collisions (constantly consuming electricity) (huge heat release) [Built: Atomic mine]
[*] Ion pump: can more efficiently eliminate and reduce the value of bacteria and radiation, create a clean and sanitary environment [Construction: atomic mine]
[*] Gel wall: can eliminate large area noise [Construction: Aerogel]
[*] Eternal Star Sculpture: (High decoration +100) (while increasing nearby mood, inspiration) [Construction: Glass + superconducting ore]
[*] Satellite expansion gameplay: * Satellites need to be mounted with the main rocket, and then launched together, no need to recover * (increased motion orbit line) (electromagnetic)
[*] Weather satellite: can adjust the world temperature [Build: chip + superconducting ore] (consumes a lot of fuel → fire gel)
[*] Photovoltaic satellite: directly absorb stellar beams in space extremely efficient power generation [Construction: chip + atomic ore + superconducting ore]
[/list]

[h2] Crew Tag Expansion [/h2]

[list]
[*] Captain Title (retained) : The captain has the ability to escape death, and can be revived after 1 day of death, while boosting morale
[*] The store increases the purchase of prisoners, recruited prisoners may escape in the next few days so players need to find a way to naturalize
[*] Prisoner: will not work, but will need to consume food, and may even beat the crew, will automatically assimilate randomly every once in a while
[*] Priest: (not yet completed)
[*] Traitor: If the crew is poorly treated for a long time, then the crew may consider mutiny, first by sabotage, and finally by deserting the team
[/list]

[h2] Optimization and repair [/h2]

notes.title: 1.7 Update: Fixes, Performance, Mods, Islands, Events, Talents
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. I'm just asking. Long time no see. Just now I have pushed the 1.7 update patch, I have been working on this big release all November, so the update content is still rich.

I put the necessary finishing touches on some of the legacy planning for 1.6 (including: [b] adding a lot of random events, talents, performance optimizations [/b]), while also implementing the initial requirements for the carefully prepared 1.7 plan (including: [b] Crash system, optimized MOD support, new "wastland" islands [/b]).

If you have not yet experienced the attention of the player, take advantage of this autumn promotion activity can start to try oh ~ if you are already supported by our players, then we immediately start to introduce this update content!

[h2] breakdown reaction [/h2]

The game will usher in more chain management mechanism gameplay, while adding the character "other" property page, you can view these attributes and the character's inherent attributes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41857044/c4389cd0f493694a1f239038f3ebaa16883dd673.png[/img]

[h3] Crash reaction [/h3] You act up when you're depressed
[olist]
[*] Demolition (wanton destruction of surrounding buildings)
[*] Arson (wantonly arson, vent anger)
[*] Poisoning (poisoning revenge)
[*] Fighting (conflict intensifies leading to fighting)
[*] Name-calling (endless abuse of others)
[*] Binge eating
[*] Crying (makes constant noise and is offensive)
[*] Open discharge (open discharge of sewage)
[*] Gossip makers (people who spread doomsday rhetoric and scare people)
[*] Gambling addiction: People who are in a bad mood will gamble and usually lose money (crazy addiction to the roulette table)
[*] Nightmare: Ghosts appear (Fleet mode mechanism has been replaced)
[/olist]
[h3] Joy response [/h3] Helps people when they are happy
[olist]
[*] Flying: plus moving speed (run fast)
[*] Work flow: speed up work (improve work efficiency, shorten working hours)
[*] Berserker: Increased attacks (Bloodthirsty warlike, more brave)
[*] Trendy art: randomly make the building more decorative (decorate the surrounding scenery)
[*] Performer: similar use of instruments (playing music to delight the crowd)
[*] Food dedication: randomly make food for everyone (make food to share with everyone)
[*] Circus clown: To make everyone laugh, restore the mood (perform stunts to make everyone laugh, restore the mood)
[/olist]

[h2]MOD Workshop Optimization [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41857044/181a6c7d8d9b4bf2392227dfdf68be8e9cad293e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Simplify the material pack Mod production process
[*] Optimized Mod panel layout
[*] Optimization Mod takes effect immediately when enabled
[*] Added Mod reset record button to prevent status record error
[*] Optimize Mod panel display: increase prompt types (stickers, packages) and sources (local, Steam), and support one-click upload ↓
[*] New Mod Updated Toggle: Automatically fill in the title and description and other information
[*] at the same time I uploaded the MOD tutorial [url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1C8BmYGEbT] MOD tutorial video [/ url]
[/list]

[h2] Performance optimization [/h2]

This deep optimization has a significant effect, even in the late stage can have 30 to 60 frames

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41857044/2436a0f2a5e5d83948c31dab3062417200f294ec.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Optimize physical simulation performance consumption such as building inspection
[*] Optimization of ship movement physical simulation performance cost
[*] Optimize pipeline performance
[*] Optimize building canvas performance
[/list]

[h2] Add random events [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41857044/bd8d20600b39b00c26e52c209e31b98866ef0ff4.png[/img]

[h3] Favorable event [/h3]
[olist]
[*] Reverse engineering: Previously unlocked tech nodes have a chance to recover some inspiration
[*] Animals falling into the water: Random (2-3) small animals appear on the boat
[*] Everything revives: Random planting of crops for unplanted soil boxes
[*] Dead Rising: All the dead on the ship directly become children
[*] Discover Floating Island: Randomly refresh a floating island
[*] Marine litter: Randomly add multiple garbage bags
[*] Divine Blessing: A random crew member removes all bad talents
[*] Cloning: You will get an identical crew clone, but the maximum health is only 50
[*] Refresh with old: Restores all deck durability
[*] Emergency shift: The crew's energy is restored and the sleeping mission interrupted
[*] Love Ratio: Random one crew member's social relationship degree randomly reaches full rank
[*] Going out for fun: Crew members get some random gems when they return (can be recalled early, but then lose the harvest)
[*] Reinforcement supplies: Drop a special treasure chest at a random location, which contains this delicate food, water and medicine
[*] Fish migration: A large number of random fish appear on the deck
[/olist]
[h3] Bad event [/h3]
[olist]
[*] Dust storm: obstructs the view of the crew (and slows down, only shows when the ship is near the island)
[*] Volcanic eruption: Directly triggers a meteorite weather
[*] Iron Rain: Drop a lot of stones, may injure the crew, but can also gain a lot of ore, metal
[*] Blood Rain: Crew contact deteriorates mood, may fight, may also refresh some zombies
[*] Load imbalance: random electrical explosion and fire
[*] Water pollution: Loss of 10 bottles (-50%, maximum 50) of fresh water resources
[*] Equipment wear: All stored equipment has a high (-50%) chance of damage (-50% durability)
[*] Disrepair: All ship buildings have a small probability of damage waiting to be repaired (excluding decks and other tiles)
[*] Loss of control: The direction of the vessel is reversed from the operation for a short period of time
[*] God's Rage: Rage will burn a crew member continuously (every 5 seconds for 100 seconds)
[*] Plague outbreak: 3 to 10 rats randomly appear on the ship (and spread poisoning)
[*] Nuclear crisis: Unfortunately, a nuclear leak results in increased radiation levels (+50) (only during or after the radiation phase) (zombies, putrid bodies, radioactive debris at sea will also appear)
[*] General strike: Crew members do not work for a period of time
[*] Fishing ban: No overfishing (all fishing missions are suspended during this period)
[/olist]

[h2] Added Talent [/h2]

[h3] Advantages [/h3]
[olist]
[*] Alcohol tolerance: not drunk for a long time
[*] Socializer: Socialize with people more frequently
[*] Ascetic monk: The higher the pressure (pressure - comfort), the better the mood
[*] Thick skin: Damage has a chance to increase maximum health
[*] Writer: Has the chance to produce books in his spare time
[*] Pharmacist: Chance to make potions when free
[*] Blood Pact: Transfer 50% damage to teammates when wounded
[*] Pirate Buster: Has a chance to make pirates disappear when attacked by pirates
[*] Senior electrician: The generator built by him will increase the power by 25%, and the appliance will reduce the power consumption by 25%.
[*] Flame: Can be lit at night (permanent)
[*] Not afraid of heat and cold: not afraid of heat and cold
[/olist]
[h3] Disadvantages [/h3]
[olist]
[*] Binge drinking: frequency of drinking
[*] Chattering: His bubble speech occurs more frequently
[*] Bomb Kid: Periodically has the chance to refresh a bomb beside the ship
[*] Electromagnetic fear: the presence of electromagnetic buildings around will be upset
[*] Streaker: The equipment field is 0
[*] Appearance association: prefer people who are more attractive than oneself; They hate people below them
[*] Snoring like thunder: sleep will affect the quality of sleep around
[*] Deafness: will no longer be affected by noise, but will be in a bad mood all the time, and focus (energy) is better
[*] Illiterate: IQ of 0, unable to engage in research
[*] Radiator: Continuously radiating radiation particles outward
[*] Corruption Infection: There is a small chance of breeding a zombie
[/olist]

[h2] Floating island mechanism [/h2]

Floating island mechanism: An island is refreshed approximately every 20 days

notes.title: 🎃Update: Misty Forest & Controller Support & Happy Halloween🎃
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. I'm trying to make it work.
At the beginning of the month, we carried out the National Day promotion, and harvested a group of new players, and everyone also gave me a lot of feedback and optimization suggestions, so I almost every day in the non-stop code modification and bug repair. During this period, some players also asked about Steam Deck compatibility issues, so I began to pay attention to the gamepad and console play experience, and it took a lot of effort to finally complete. In addition to these experience upgrades, I've added the "Misty Forest" story essentials, which include new ecological communities, new Vientiane Misty technology blueprints, and resources related to hallucinogenic spores to make your adventure a little more interesting
Next, let's get straight to what's new!

Please test your own console players and feedback your playing experience with me. I will continue to pay attention to this issue. [/b]

notes.title: Important Update: Adventure Mode Preview & Art renovation
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this month I focus on the development of "adventure mode", considering that a large number of players do not adapt to the original God perspective control and planning of the fleet of gameplay, so I plan to develop a parallel role-playing gameplay mechanism, players can choose to control one of the crew to drift and survive on the sea, which will be a new experience. I simplified the behavior of landing, collecting, attacking, etc., and added new behavior mechanisms such as sprinting, manipulation, and sleeping. The development progress is faster than I expected. Although I have conducted a lot of tests, there will certainly be strange bugs during the play, so please contact me or direct community feedback if you have any questions, thank you. I hope you like the new game mode, and I have also fixed some bugs, so the current experience should be better! Without further ado, take a look at the update below.

[h2] Adventure Mode [/h2]

notes.title: Climactic Battle: Reinforcements Arrive, Skill System and UI Upgrades
notes.content:
Hello everyone, imperceptibly passed more than a month, time really quickly, during this period of time happened a lot of things, I am also very emotional, in short, everything is calm, I can be happy to make their own games. [i] During this period, I improved the final plot and true ending according to the normal false ending process of "Radiation Crisis", which meant that "Ocean Current Punk" welcomed the moment of the end of the plot, and my heart was very excited. This was the first time for me to write a game story, as if I had personally experienced it, and as if I had made a dream of a long journey. [/i] hope you can also take part in it and experience that different story. [b] Although the overall plot is complete, I have a lot of side plots planned, such as fighting pirates, investigating ruins, etc., so the story is still developing, let's see where it goes. [/b]

In this episode I added new "radiation technology" blueprints, including some new radiation power generation devices, and radiation defense towers; There's also a new "radiation sickness" particle infection mechanism, and your little man may inadvertently fluoresce. As well as improving those powerful radiation creatures from last month, and adding the final boss "Alien Queen", as well as the long-awaited "Space reinforcements", they have finally unraveled the veil ~.
The second is to improve the "Abyss of Terror" story elements, I added a new "Shadow Technology" blueprint, which also includes some interesting new powerful buildings.
I also added a new "skill system" where the crew gets inspired to learn different skills to improve their work efficiency, but you also need to pay attention to their personal preferences and choose the skills they are good at and divide the team.
Finally, I optimized the overall UI style, and now it is more flat and smooth, I think it should be more close to the lovely game style (does anyone think it is very much like win11 ha ha ha).

According to the plan map, we will add more technical blueprints, terrain ecology, and random plot in the future, so stay tuned for updates on the game, thank you.

notes.content:
Hello everyone, this update I will release a number of new system early preview versions, mainly for the late game experience, I will continue to update and improve them, expect to be fully completed by the end of the year stay tuned. I also fixed a lot of bugs, thanks to the players who gave me that feedback, and I also improved the performance of the game, which will significantly improve your graphics even at 3x speed. If you haven't played the game in more than three months, try it again this time.

[h3] Festival Celebration (Finished) [/h3]

We are once again celebrating Dragon Boat Festival for a week. We believe that games are not just a closed virtual space, they should be connected to everyone's real life. We are passionate about sharing that joy and culture, and we will open up more fun festival activities in the future.
To this end, we added a festival manager: we managed the festival exclusively as a separate system. We also added more festivals to the World Lab (preview)

notes.title: Ocean Punk official version released
notes.content:
Dear players and friends, good morning, noon, and evening,

Since the early access of "Ocean Punk" on STEAM, we have received a lot of feedback from many companions, including many excellent ideas (and a billion bugs). Yet, we also feel the wonderful resonance among game enthusiasts.

Over the past year of early access, the game has undergone updates for three major chapters (with a total of 147 patch updates, approximately 30 significant updates). Recently, the STEAM reviews have turned into "Overwhelmingly Positive," fueling the creators' enthusiasm. They promise to continue improving the game, striving to make it better together with the players.
 We are excited to announce that "Ocean Punk" is scheduled to officially release on April 2, 2024, accompanied by a significant discount for those eager to dive in.

Compared to the initial version, the official release will include:
- New content: About 50+ side quests, 30 random events, 30 new buildings, around 20 spells, a substantial addition of at least 20+ creatures, 5 new bosses with related special buildings, and 3 different endings.
- Additions: Bacteria system, diving mechanics, room system, fog mechanism, radiation system, animal husbandry mechanics, pet system, brewing building (and related buffs).
- New terrains: Seaweed forest terrain, Coral Reef Ruins.
- New inhabitants: Fish people communities, more NPC companions.
- Increased randomness in loot drops, out-of-map growth mechanism, social system, interactions among ship AI, more narrative and gameplay.
- New consumables: Dishes or drinks (10+).
- Additional crafting recipes and effect items (20+).
- Seasonal features including world effects (temperature, sunlight, etc.), seasonal creatures, and events.
- Redesigned and enriched circuit systems, pipeline systems.
- Revamped about 30 building artworks.
- Overhauled sea chart mechanics with new features like marking and teleportation.
- Completed story design, introduced old-time information gathering media such as newspapers, advertisements, posters, added a radio with 50+ voiceovers, more equipment and related mechanics (durability, additional effects, etc.).
- Deeply optimized UI interfaces with additional tutorials.
- Opening up a creative workshop.
- Adding an in-game Wiki encyclopedia.
- Incorporating 40+ sound effects and multiple BGM tracks.

notes.title: 洋流朋克即将升级为正式版！
notes.content:
Dear players and friends, good morning, noon, and evening,

Since the early access of "Ocean Punk" on STEAM, we have received a lot of feedback from many companions, including many excellent ideas (and a billion bugs). Yet, we also feel the wonderful resonance among game enthusiasts.

Over the past year of early access, the game has undergone updates for three major chapters (with a total of 147 patch updates, approximately 30 significant updates). Recently, the STEAM reviews have turned into "Overwhelmingly Positive," fueling the creators' enthusiasm. They promise to continue improving the game, striving to make it better together with the players.
 We are excited to announce that "Ocean Punk" is scheduled to officially release on April 26, 2024, accompanied by a significant discount for those eager to dive in.

Compared to the initial version, the official release will include:
- New content: About 50+ side quests, 30 random events, 30 new buildings, around 20 spells, a substantial addition of at least 20+ creatures, 5 new bosses with related special buildings, and 3 different endings.
- Additions: Bacteria system, diving mechanics, room system, fog mechanism, radiation system, animal husbandry mechanics, pet system, brewing building (and related buffs).
- New terrains: Seaweed forest terrain, Coral Reef Ruins.
- New inhabitants: Fish people communities, more NPC companions.
- Increased randomness in loot drops, out-of-map growth mechanism, social system, interactions among ship AI, more narrative and gameplay.
- New consumables: Dishes or drinks (10+).
- Additional crafting recipes and effect items (20+).
- Seasonal features including world effects (temperature, sunlight, etc.), seasonal creatures, and events.
- Redesigned and enriched circuit systems, pipeline systems.
- Revamped about 30 building artworks.
- Overhauled sea chart mechanics with new features like marking and teleportation.
- Completed story design, introduced old-time information gathering media such as newspapers, advertisements, posters, added a radio with 50+ voiceovers, more equipment and related mechanics (durability, additional effects, etc.).
- Deeply optimized UI interfaces with additional tutorials.
- Opening up a creative workshop.
- Adding an in-game Wiki encyclopedia.
- Incorporating 40+ sound effects and multiple BGM tracks.

notes.title: Whole process optimization, new pipeline system, why not drink? More secrets!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, after two months, the update announcement has finally arrived. There is quite a lot of content in this update, so please be patient and check it out.
This update will focus on optimizing details and overall experience, making subsequent gameplay smoother and the values more reasonable.
[h2] Core content [/h2]
[h3] Pipeline system [/h3]
[olist]
[*] Pipeline hub: Similar to electric poles, used for collecting and distributing liquids
[*] Add pipes: Similar to electric wires, with circular plates added in the middle of the curved design for component effects of conveying materials, which can replace the special effects of water pumps
[*] Water delivery speed adjustment (↓): Pipeline and "fuel" data not stored
The water droplets in the pipeline should be highlighted in the circuit view
[*] Optimize the art of water pumps (refer to generators)
[*] Add wave effects to buildings beyond the deck
[*] Add sewage tank (new): It needs to be constructed with decaying materials, and after being powered on, it can continuously generate sewage
The color of different types of liquid markings (in pipeline views) should be different
[*] Adding a splitter: allows for the presence of multiple liquids in the pipeline; The splitter needs to be connected to a pipeline
[*] Remaking fertilizer machines into fertilizer factories: efficiently producing fertilizers using wastewater
[*] Remake the water purifier: replace it with sewage (pipeline) purification (differentiate it from pure electrical appliances by consuming less electricity)
[*] Fire extinguishers and irrigation devices connected to pipelines
[*] Remake the horizontally extended faucet (drain port): It can package the liquid in the pipeline into resources and discharge them
[/olist]
 [h3]Why not drink alcohol? [/h3]
[olist]
[*] Add opening carry: beer
[*] Adding a chance of fighting after drinking alcohol
[*] Repairs abnormal alcohol addiction that has not been alleviated despite continuous drinking
[*] Add alcohol withdrawal buff
[*] Shorten the drunken buff time and add a description
[/olist]
[h3] Secret Technique Improvement [/h3]
[olist]
[*] Knowledge sharing: Crew members have a 30% chance of receiving inspiration from others as well
[*] Read extensively: There is a chance to obtain new books during leisure time
[*] Energy Battery: All crew members receive an additional 50% of maximum energy
Prohibition: Crew members will be prohibited from drinking alcohol
[*] Healthy diet: Eating increases extra life, energy, and mood
[*] Enduring Friendship: Continuously increasing friendship among crew members
[*] Cooking Recipe: Cooking may drop double the amount of food
[*] Armistice Contract: There is a 20% chance to skip a wave of enemies
[*] Gunfire: When crew members use firearms, two magic balls will be added
[*] Anti damage stab armor: percentage of anti damage after injury (30%)
[*] Trauma team: When a character dies, rescue efforts will be quickly initiated, but high costs will need to be paid
[*] Dodge Skill: There is a chance to dodge enemy attacks
[*] Coupon: When consuming coins, 20% will be refunded
[*] Call to Faith: Recruiting crew members in taverns will no longer require coins
[*] Rich Legacy: A random treasure chest drops when a crew member dies
[/olist]
[h2] Detail optimization [/h2]
[olist]
[*] Optimizing exploration on Iceland: Low desire (increasing demand for more materials)
[olist]
[*] Increase Moonstone Mine: Increase More Construction Demand
[*] Increase ice essence
[*] Increase Extreme Cold Cordyceps: Guardian Iceland, long-range attack
[/olist]
[*] Improve oxygen related systems and sewage treatment systems (pipeline systems)
[*] Increase oxygen related systems: mainly consumed for diving and rocket launch
[*] Add laser dome: The function of sandbags is transferred to the new laser dome (but can only defend against "low altitude" meteorites)
[*] Optimizing Little Dinosaurs: They sleep at night, so they should be able to catch them on the boat (and then they can reproduce wildly, but they will also excrete wildly)
[*] Optimize teleportation monument: teleportation may get stuck, and volume can be ignored for a period of time after teleportation
[*] Add unique resource drop: Only one of the subitems in the resource drop package will be dropped
When adding an alert state, it will automatically return to one speed (after the alert is cleared, it can automatically return to the previous speed);
[*] Add automatic follow camera when landing and returning
[*] Add a button for "Go All" on the link board
[*] Optimize standard colors to make them more vibrant!
[*] Increase sleep threshold to reduce daytime sleep frequency
[*] Add multi deck tile transition (visual)
[*] Add deck quick upgrade
[*] Add the "long-range attack" effect of firearms
[*] Add "Forest Hate": If too many trees are cut down, 1-3 tree demon seeds will appear (1 tree=10, -0.1 per second) (coordinated by the disaster manager)
[*] Problem of delayed role response after optimizing task allocation (changing AI task polling increment to 0.1)
[*] Add color differentiation for good and bad buffs in the crew panel (including task sub items)
[*] Reduce the probability of triggering most events (20+)
[*] Optimize Continuing Task Animation: Sleep interrupts the research task, and the animation does not switch to work when resuming the task after waking up (including running without switching animation after sleep interruption)
[*] Adding a question mark on the image of a character on a business trip, similar to death
[*] Add tasks to be grouped as individual roles for execution as much as possible
Add a prop bar in the resource view
When a fish or other creature caught on a boat dies, it should fall onto the boat
[*] Each shrine should only be dedicated to one soul, and when used, it should be illuminated to indicate that the animation and buttons must be synchronized
[*] The chart camera is no longer affected by lighting
[*] "Crew members still frequently get stuck on the empty deck" (tentative repair)
[*] Adjust the frequency of ocean current season rainfall (while adjusting the probability of flying fish rain (↓))
[*] Optimize the conditions for animals on board to be attacked by weapons: Some animals must be protected
[*] The border and color of the secret technique node are synchronized with the technology tree
[*] The secret technique demo version is automatically locked
[*] Fish man scale processed into fish man essence
[*] Increase inspiration and kill point disappearance mechanism (if not used for a long time, it will slowly and automatically decrease)
[*] When a pile of construction tasks cannot be carried out, some will automatically disappear, and it is necessary to keep trying to redo or wait when resources are scarce (and occasionally when resources are scarce, the construction task cannot be deleted because the 'IsFailWait' was not modified when actively deleting the task, resulting in still error detection)
[*] Add a global task manager view to display all tasks in 'TaskController' (for debugging purposes)
[*] Increase a small amount of gold mines in the jungle
[*] Add an attack button to the livestock attribute panel
When crew members suffer damage from the magic ball, they should counterattack the "host" enemy
Moonlight stones should not produce turkeys
[*] Juicer lacks function: temporarily make it into a single output function similar to a wooden barrel, use * fruit x2 * to obtain * juice *, restore a large amount of vitamin C and moisture
[*] Steam engine switching and refueling mode removal (internal combustion components automatically refuel uniformly)
[*] Simplify the production cost of regular bait (only one vegetable is needed)
Performance optimization of path finding algorithm consumption
[*] For buildings with manual switches, add "unique markings" instead of a unified power outage icon, which can be easily confused
[*] The formula for clay jars needs to be simplified: 1. Soil
[*] The furnace cannot burn coal and once it works, it cannot be stopped (temporarily hidden)
[*] Map size modification is prohibited in the tutorial level, and the perspective following will be cancelled at the beginning of the tutorial level (otherwise the game cannot continue); Harvest tutorial text overlap
[*] Optimization of Rope Pirates: Resources dropped due to death may not be on board the ship, and crew members may not be able to collect anomalies
[*] Adding fish (sea wolf fish) should not go to the island (similar to adding a terrain activity detection for creatures on the road)
[*] Garbage bags must drop garbage and some other things
[*] Optimize the drying rack: Change the material to foodtag (food type)
[*] A prompt window appears before triggering the world boss: asking the player if they should trigger the challenge (after all, world bosses are usually actively challenged by the player, and cannot be suddenly attacked to catch beginners off guard)
[*] Simplify mod panel
[*] The alert mode will also execute boarding
[*] Infants increase their excretion and feeding abilities, thereby increasing the difficulty of raising them
[*] Sudden changes in ocean waves during the current season or other periods: appearing in rows of three at a time
Mining ore will reduce the frequency of rock beetles and magma fractures
[*] Adjust the character avatar list: elongate downwards and align with the bottom right side
[*] Add crystal energy and meteorite weather timer data archives (to prevent recalculation every time the file is read)
The electromagnetic component materials produced by universal machine tools will be changed to iron ingots and coils in the later period (so the manganese nodules will be moved back to later buildings, such as electronic equipment stations)
[*] The toilet and fish appear at the coordinate origin after reading the file, and the actual coordinates are repaired
[*] The refrigeration unit is very weak, and the temperature can only drop to below 0 ° C, causing the crew to feel cold (it needs to refer to the cold ice bonfire or adjust the temperature range)
[*] Fluorescent lamps increase aesthetics (+5)
The world temperature at night should decrease appropriately (-10)
[*] Increase event triggering interval mechanism: prevent multiple enemy events such as beast riots from being triggered simultaneously
[*] Reduce the breeding speed of small dinosaurs
[*] Optimize architectural art: solid wood beds, light bulbs, soil cultivation boxes lack borders, fishing mats
[*] Remake NPC Tent as "Abandoned Camp": Crew members can heal and heal as soon as they get close, while increasing the number of items (also shown on the sea map after activation)
[*] Simplify the main scene UI
[olist]
[*] Add a progress bar under the UI for time and other details
Simplify or hide timers to free up UI space
The resource view on the left can add an "optional display" button in the upper left corner
[*] Redo crew avatar button (more UI friendly)
[/olist]
[/olist]
[h2] Bug fix [/h2]
[olist]
[*] Repair Incubator: Animals raised are abnormal when they are not on board after reading files
[*] Fix the abnormality of consuming alcohol indiscriminately and unable to accurately drink alcohol when experiencing alcohol addiction
[*] Fixed boss health bar blocking issue on technology books
[*] Fixed some cases where the wooden barrel did not brew beer abnormally
[*] Fixed abnormal perspective tracking while reading files
[*] Fix a situation where the "food shortage" prompt does not disappear (after testing, it was found that there was a problem with creating a temporary prompt because it defaults to creating a prompt with id: 0, which is "food shortage")
[*] Repairing simple evaporating dishes and double bottle evaporating dishes. If the fuel mission fails midway (or fails halfway through), fuel will not be automatically added in the future,
[*] Players cannot manually add fuel exceptions
[*] Fixed a problem where the enemy timer was negative after reading files, and there were no exceptions when the enemy exceeded the timeout (and occasional seasons were not changed)
[*] Repairing view switching requires clicking twice for exceptions
[*] When repairing the internal combustion engine is short of fuel, it may still be too laggy, and the crew keeps sending resources in, but it has failed
[*] When repairing the file reading and then removing the equipment, the equipment disappears without any abnormalities
[*] When repairing fishing, logging in will result in fishing on the island, and after execution, no abnormalities will be found
[*] Fixed abnormal display of dark patches when opening the map at the same time as the view mask was opened
[*] Fixed the issue of still unable to transport resources, causing abnormal operation of furnaces and brewing
[*] Fixed abnormal situation where crew members are no longer performing work tasks after playing for a while
[*] Repairing the lantern boat: It's not good to push it lightly and run away (increasing a lot of friction, only the crew can put it on and then float away on their own)
[*] Fixed abnormal crew relationships in long-term archives: displayed only relationships between oneself and oneself
[*] Fixed turbo generator. Even if it was shut down, the animation did not change (the generator is not affected by shutdown)
[*] Fixed still too frequent events: Siege Day, Beast Riots, Raiders, Sunwind (also too long), El Ni ñ o/La Ni ñ a
[*] Fixed abnormal archiving of cooking plans for cookware
[*] Fixed a bug where the storm boss can directly attack the main body: because the vulnerability caused by crew injuries will automatically seek out enemies
[*] Fixed a bug in the ice wall where teleportation can escape the storm boss: teleportation needs to be prohibited during this period
[*] Fixed an issue where the treasure did not display an icon on the map
[*] Fix the anomaly in the tutorial where the direction of the fire moth is reversed
[*] Fix that "extraterrestrial events" can cause multiple boss exceptions to occur simultaneously
[*] Fixed the view mask. If you switch modes when it appears in construction mode, it will not disappear unless you switch back to construction mode, which is abnormal
[*] Fixed the exception where Flamingo cannot be attacked
[*] Fixed the issue where the hot launcher unexpectedly restores health to the dead
[/olist]
[h2] Sound effects (new synchronization) [/h2]
[olist]
[*] The sound of magma cracks and flames spewing out
[*] Flying fish flying sound effect, entering water sound effect
[*] Open posters, advertisements, and other sound effects
[*] Activate alert sound effects
[*] The sound of piercing traps poking out
[*] Obtain inspiration and slaughter sounds
[*] Ship gunfire
Dolphin calls
[*] New pathogen infection prompt sound (for this type of prompt box, there are also unlocking secrets (* technology already exists *) and fishing)
[*] The call to fight when farmers and other NPCs appear
[*] The sound of anvil tapping
[*] * * Special effects such as wind, snow, psychics, volcanic ash, etc**
[*] * The unboxing sound is a bit eerie, continuous, and needs to be changed frequently*
The bell for the new day is too long (it's best to only ring twice)*
[*] The sound of a flush toilet
[*] Create a mini map marker sound
[*] Sprinkler sound (available for irrigation and fire protection)
[*] Ice spikes increase attack sound effects (temporarily using spikes)
[/olist]
[h2] Configure translation (synchronize recent updates) [/h2]
[olist]
[*] Fishing reminder "new record"
[*] Button at the top of the link board
[*] Current civilization points
[*] Killing lacks description
[*] Encyclopedia homepage
[*] Description of coffee beans
[*] Description of fertilizer synthesis machine on the technology tree and name on the console
[*] Construction "Plan" Title
[*] Transfer monument buttons, panels
[*] Resurrection Stone Pillar Button
[*] Fuel adding button for the furnace
[*] NPC ability button
[*] Marking prompts and buttons on the chart panel
[*] Brewing button and panel
[*] Guide tower button and initial prompt panel for guide gameplay
[*] Prop labels in resource view (in Chinese and English)
[*] Quick tutorial and check box for creating a world panel
[/olist]
[h2] Special adjustments [/h2]
In the official version, all old names such as "OceanCurrentPunk" need to be replaced (unified as "OceanPunk")

notes.title: [Gameplay Update/Operation Optimization] Added Events、Occult 、Bacteria、Room sys
notes.content:
It has been a long time since I saw you. A month later, Ocean Current Punk had another regular update, during which the update slowed down because I was busy with some other affairs. The good news is that the update frequency will be resumed in the future.



[h2] Gameplay update [/h2]



[h3] New random event [/h3]

[list]

[*] Drift Deck: Grant multiple deck events

[*] Waterborne Baby: The event can capture a baby

[*] Great Migration: A pod of dolphins (dropping blubber, fish) will follow the ship all the time, can be hunted, and then disappear after a period of time

[*] Brainstorming: Randomly get some ideas, while the chance to wash away old ideas of the crew

[*] Ancient Echo: Randomly add more civilization values, while also having a chance to wash away old crewmembers' inspiration.

[*] Overboard: Random crew members fall to a desert island

[*] Solar Flare: All electrical appliances are temporarily disabled (for about one day)

[*] Gluttony Festival: All crew members are directly fed to zero

[*] Songkran Festival: The crew will be wet, stagnant and happy to varying degrees

[*] Halloween: Multiple ghosts appear

[*] Holiday party: everyone eats and drinks together for a short break, which quickly increases mood and * also creates more opportunities for communication * (no side effects)

[*] Dionysian Day: Everyone wants to drink and if they can't, they get into fights or get depressed

[*] Cargo explosion: Random two or three buildings catch fire

[*] Biological invasion: barnacles, algae (vines) plants grow on the deck, need to be picked in time (grass, fish), otherwise affect the degree of decoration

[*] Beast Riot: Directly refresh a round of enemies (mid and late stages)

[*] Hunt Day: Random pirates attack players (later)

[*] Drop Ship: Drop ship debris randomly. There are no aliens inside, but it gives the player some rare resources such as nickel

[*] Hail weather: Drop lots of small hail that will cause a little blood (like meteorites) (winter only)

Hello, everyone! It's been over a month since my last regular update, during which I've made several minor patch updates, including new building tech (farm stations, gun machines, rocket components, etc.), new crops (bamboo shoots, blueberry rattan), new sound effects (UI, ring tones, building sounds, etc.), new story fragments, and several bug fixes. In short, the game is better than the original!



(Refer to the past update log for a large number of updates. The following only lists the content of this patch update.)



[h3] [/h3]

[list]

[*] Launch "Spaceship" escape: Add spaceship core control, spaceship body, spaceship sleep capsule, spaceship thruster, spaceship bracket; (You need to successfully launch at least one manned spacecraft to reach the new ending, but you can still play after the ending.)

[*] Add old time radio dubbing

[*] Add newspapers, advertisements, posters and other relics of the past

[*] Reworked farmer, shepherd, shark and other NPCS directly to random visitor events.

[/list]
